author: sooner state news
title: Oklahoma Sooners lose to LSU in first round of SEC Baseball Tournament
text:
Oklahoma lost to Louisiana State University, 6-2, in the first round of the Southeastern Conference Baseball Tournament on May 20.
The loss means Oklahoma will now wait to learn if it will receive a spot in the NCAA postseason. The NCAA selection show is scheduled for Monday, May 25 at 11 a.m. Central Time on ESPN2. Oklahoma aims to qualify for its fifth consecutive and forty-third overall NCAA Tournament appearance.
The game remained scoreless through two innings before LSU scored first with a single in the third inning. Oklahoma responded in the bottom half of the third when Camden Johnson hit an RBI single after three straight base hits by the team. The Sooners took a brief lead in the fourth inning following a wild pitch and an error by LSU that allowed Brendan Brock to score after reaching base on an error.
LSU regained control with two runs in the fifth inning, scoring off a double and an errant throw home. In the eighth inning, LSU extended its lead with a two-run home run. Both teams were held scoreless in the ninth inning, ending with LSU ahead by four runs.
Statistically, Camden Johnson went one-for-three at bat with one RBI while Kyle Branch was one-for-three and scored once. Pitcher Gavyn Jones threw two innings without allowing any hits or runs but walked two batters and struck out two others. LJ Mercurius pitched two innings as well but gave up four hits and three runs (two earned), walking one batter and striking out three.
This marks just the fifth time this season that Oklahoma failed to record an extra-base hit; it last happened on April 25 against Auburn. Deiten Lachance extended his hitting streak to nine games while registering his first stolen base of this season; Dasan Harris also pushed his hitting streak to seven games. This matchup was notable as it was played using the Automated Ball-Strike System for balls and strikes calls—Oklahoma successfully challenged five out of seven calls.
